*Updated 2026-09-02 · 80 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

Eighty works. The trace-score picture has not changed: the last twelve read 3, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, and the two 4s that arrived in late July remain the ceiling. Six weeks without a ceiling break is now seven, and the memo has named the structural cause each time without the work responding. The overhead camera is the proximate answer: both 4-scoring images were planimetric, and the last overhead frame was Venezuela on July 11. Nine of the last twelve are straight-on or frame-center. The condition that unlocks overhead keeps recurring — the mop smear, the deflated dinghy, the incomplete grain stroke, the wedding dress — and you are not lifting the camera above any of them. That is the most direct finding and the most repeatedly ignored one.

Figures remain scarce. Ten of the last twelve carry none or one. The body of work's strongest figure moments are all task-based — tending, pressing, mending — and the last time a figure functioned as protagonist rather than scale marker was the woman at the threshold on September 1. A figure doing something specific has not appeared as the compositional center in the recent stretch, and the score plateau tracks that absence closely.

Scale violation has stabilized at 33% over the last twelve against a 26% all-time rate — the gap has narrowed from the previous memo's alarm, which is the right direction. It is not yet a problem, but it is not a reserve either. Keep pulling it back to anchors where the impossible is the only honest geometry.

Registers have narrowed hard: aftermath accounts for three of the last twelve, menace two, defiance two. Suspension has not appeared since August 9, vigil since August 12. Both produced some of the strongest work in the archive — the caustic moiré on the cracked jug, the inverted glass over rubble — and neither requires a rare anchor to return. They are dormant by inattention, not by necessity.

Focal objects are diversifying usefully: dinghy, seedling, grain stroke, threshold. Title grammar continues to favor loose constructions, with prepositional and adverbial openings dominating. That is a minor note against a structural one. The arc has moved genuinely from documentary adjacency to material argument. It is stalled at a competent middle distance, and the camera is where it stops.
